section_summary.extract_value: This limitations section discusses the cross-sectional nature of the study and inability to determine causation, potential biases from crowdsourcing marketplace recruitment, and notes that findings may not be representative of the wider US population. The section also highlights measurement limitations in body image scales (BI-AAQ and BASES-AP) and notes that positive body image explained only approximately 13% of variance in sexual liberalism outcomes, suggesting the need for additional variables in future research.
